_what: Outcome-blocks holding a pooled RATIO whose object declares no indirectness argument. Each needs ONE declaration -- a judgement about how far the estimate transfers -- after which an absolute-effect table becomes derivable. NO DECLARATION IS DRAFTED HERE: naming precisely what is missing IS the deliverable, because it converts an open judgement into 26 closed questions.

_denominator.note: Only the 26 are UNLOCKABLE. The other 119 decline for reasons that are CORRECT and are not gaps: there is no ratio to convert, no estimate, a mean difference (an NNT from an MD would be fabrication), or a pool the object itself withdrew.

_reconciliation: 26 blocks walking ssot/*/*.json. 23 of them are reachable from a delivered page; 3 are not -- malaria-vaccines (2 blocks) and tigecycline-ciai (1). An earlier enumeration reported 24 because it walked pages rather than stores. The store walk is authoritative; the page-reachability is recorded per row.
_is_this_a_subset_of_the_145_declaration: SUBSET BY CONSTRUCTION with a caveat. Every block here lacks an indirectness declaration, so it is a subset of any set defined that way. But the 145 counted HERE is 'declined by absolute_effect for ANY reason' and another lane's 145 is 'lacking a declaration'. They coincide in size over the same 146 denominator, which is suggestive and is NOT proof they are the same 145. A third figure, 53 of 157, is a different question over a different denominator.
